title: centaurea nigrescens subsp. neapolitana
intro: Centaurea nigrescens subsp. neapolitana, commonly known as the Neapolitan knapweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, contributing to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea nigrescens subsp. neapolitana include its ability to modulate the immune system, alleviate pain, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpene lactones, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
